topic: How does a battery light a bulb?
title: How Does a Battery Really Light a Bulb?
description:
A battery does not pour electricity into a bulb. It pushes electrons that are already in the wire around a loop, and the thin filament heats until it glows. See how it works in under a minute.

#science #physics #electricity #shorts

beats.sentence: What if a battery poured electricity into a bulb until it ran out?
beats.subject: battery
beats.change: the charge window slowly drains lower

beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the bulb lights up warm and bright

beats.sentence: The wire is already full of tiny electrons, even before you connect anything.
beats.subject: particles
beats.change: glowing electrons fill the whole length of the wire evenly

beats.sentence: Close the loop, and the battery starts pushing electrons out of its negative end.
beats.subject: particles
beats.change: the electrons start streaming away from the battery end

beats.sentence: Every electron shoves the next, so the whole line creeps slowly around the loop.
beats.subject: particles
beats.change: the whole line of electrons shifts forward together at a slow crawl

beats.sentence: But the push arrives almost instantly, so the bulb lights as soon as you connect.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the bulb switches on at once

beats.sentence: Inside the bulb, the electrons must squeeze through a hair-thin filament.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the filament starts to glow dull orange

beats.sentence: It is so narrow that they crash into its atoms, again and again.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the filament glow flickers brighter with hot spots

beats.sentence: Each crash shakes the atoms harder, heating the filament past two thousand degrees Celsius.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the filament turns from orange to white-hot

beats.sentence: Hot metal glows, and that glow is the light you see.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the whole glass fills with bright warm light

beats.subject: gear
beats.change: the linked gears start to turn together

beats.sentence: Pedal at one end, and the wheel at the other turns, while each link only goes round.
beats.subject: gear
beats.change: the far gear speeds up to match the first

beats.sentence: The battery is the pedal, and the bulb is the wheel.
beats.subject: gear
beats.change: the gears turn faster and faster together

beats.sentence: Break the loop anywhere, and the glow dies.
beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the light fades out and the bulb goes dark

beats.subject: lightbulb
beats.change: the bulb flickers back on to a soft glow
